answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A comet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the timber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The knoll of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
